# Constantine Blyuz

> Energy consultant, lecturer and author. Former Deputy Director of Israel’s Natural Gas Authority (2010–2020), former Israeli diplomat, co-founder and chairman of an NGO.

Personal site, published in three languages: English (/en/), Russian (/ru/) and Hebrew (/he/). Every page is static HTML and readable without JavaScript. Last updated: 2026-10-20.

## Main pages

- [English edition](https://www.cblyuz.com/en/): Constantine Blyuz has worked in the Israeli and regional energy industry since 2004 — Deputy Director of the Natural Gas Authority, First Secretary at Israeli embassies in Ukraine and Moldova, lecturer, and author of the novel The Wide Expanse of the Free.
- [Russian edition](https://www.cblyuz.com/ru/): биография, газовая политика, кейсы, публикации и контакты.
- [Hebrew edition](https://www.cblyuz.com/he/): פרופיל מקצועי, מדיניות הגז הטבעי, תיק עבודות ייעוץ, פרסומים ופרטי קשר.

## Writing

- [Israel’s gas decade: what regulation actually built](https://www.cblyuz.com/en/writing/gas-decade.html): What a decade of natural gas regulation actually built in Israel — licensing, tariffs, network development and market rules.
- [Diplomacy at the pipeline: energy as a language between states](https://www.cblyuz.com/en/writing/energy-diplomacy.html): On energy as a working language of diplomacy, written from two embassies.
- [On writing a novel while working in government](https://www.cblyuz.com/en/writing/novel-and-office.html): An essay on writing fiction in the hours around a public sector job.
- [Interview with Kosatka Energy Media, 2019 (PDF)](https://www.cblyuz.com/assets/docs/blyuz-interview-kosatka.pdf)
- [Cooperation between the regulatory authorities of Israel, Spain and Türkiye, 2018 (PDF)](https://www.cblyuz.com/assets/docs/blyuz-turkey-spain-2018.pdf)

## Books and music

- [Selected chapters of the novel](https://www.cblyuz.com/en/chapters.html): Selected chapters from The Wide Expanse of the Free, the debut novel by Constantine Blyuz.
- [The musical: No One in Front of the Mirror](https://www.cblyuz.com/en/musical.html): Full synopsis of No One in Front of the Mirror, a chamber musical with book and lyrics by Constantine Blyuz.
